_readme: Known files over the 500-line convention (claudedocs/client-modules.md / claudedocs/server.md, '单文件 500 行收敛'). Paths below are relative to client/src/ (the --root passed to the shared scripts/checkFileLength.mjs), so e.g. "net/ApiClient.ts" means client/src/net/ApiClient.ts. checkFileLength.mjs fails CI only if a file NOT listed here crosses 500 lines, a listed file grows past the line count recorded here, or (2026-08-13, G3) an entry has no 'reason' or its 'lines' exceeds the 800-line hard cap. Schema: { "path": { "lines": <number>, "reason": "<why this is a justified exception>" } }. Splitting a file below 500 lines does not require touching this file (reported as a housekeeping notice instead of failing) but delete its entry and move the note into claudedocs/client-modules.md's 已完成 list. Do not bump 'lines' to silence a GREW violation without updating 'reason' to actually explain the growth. 2026-08-13 audit found 11 of the 19 entries below had accumulated with no written justification at all (some for 2+ days) — the schema change here exists specifically to make that impossible going forward; see claudedocs/client-modules.md's CI-gate-refactor note for the full audit.

game/meta/SaveManager.ts.reason: Single cohesive cloud-sync orchestrator class (get/subscribe/persist/update/patchLocal/setFlag/equip-helpers/bootstrap/refresh/adoptSession/resetForLogout/spendStaminaForLevel/recordClear/reconcile) — all read/mutate the same core private fields (local/pending/api/wallet/progress state). Same 'single shared-state+business-logic root' shape as CityScene/core.ts's historical exception.

net/ApiClient.ts.reason: Thin one-line-per-endpoint forwarding facade over a composition split (2026-08-11). Every line exists because dozens of call sites across the codebase already call `apiClient.methodName(...)` directly; no shared/tangled state to separate, splitting the facade further would just fragment the forward list.

net/WorldApiClient.ts.reason: Same thin-forwarding-facade shape as ApiClient.ts above (shrunk 712→534 by the 2026-08-11 composition conversion; 534→542 on 2026-08-14 adding setFamilyEmblem/setSectEmblem, two more one-line forwards for the new emblem-picker endpoints; 542→544 on 2026-08-19 re-exporting the WorldCityNodeView type for the published-city-node rendering fix) — dozens of call sites already call `worldApi.methodName(...)` directly.
